title: 1 Thessalonians: hope that does not give up

lines: First Thessalonians is very likely the oldest of Paul's letters to survive, written around the year fifty.
Forced to leave by night, he had left a few new believers facing hard neighbors. Timothy brings good news, and Paul writes in relief.

scripture.text: Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news

lines: The first half looks back: thanks for their faith, love, and hope, and how Paul lived among them. The second looks ahead: holiness, love, quiet work, and the Lord's coming.
Every chapter ends near the same place.

scripture.text: your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope

lines: Most of these believers had worshiped idols until a few weeks before, and they turned to serve the living and true God.
Paul lived among them, gentle as a nursing mother and caring as a father, working night and day so as not to be a burden.

scripture.text: how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God

lines: Some believers had died, and the living feared they had missed the Lord's coming. Paul doesn't tell them not to grieve.
He tells them not to grieve like those without hope, because Jesus died and rose again.
And so we will always be with the Lord.

scripture.text: And so we will always be with the Lord.

lines: Every Christian tradition confesses that Jesus will come again and the dead will be raised. Christians differ on the order of events, and on whether being caught up is a separate rapture. This film takes no side.
The Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
So no one should set a date, or name a living person, a nation, or an event of our own day as what these verses describe.

scripture.text: the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

lines: The letter ends with short commands for life together. Respect leaders. Care for the weak. Rejoice. Pray. Give thanks. Test everything.
Waiting for the Lord means living well among your neighbors, not leaving them behind.
Read it in one sitting, as a pastor's letter to new believers he loves. Read the end of chapter four for what Paul says it's for.
Therefore encourage one another with these words.

scripture.text: Therefore encourage one another with these words.

lines: Whom are you grieving, and where is your hope?
titleCard: Hope that does not give up.
